details: Bitcoin briefly topped $84,000 before retreating on October 13, as broader Asian equity markets, including South Korea's KOSPI, experienced a significant sell-off triggered by concerns over AI valuations and Chinese competition. Despite the downturn in traditional markets, Bitcoin showed resilience, though it remains closely tied to risk assets. Over $812 million in leveraged crypto positions were liquidated in the past 24 hours, with 84.3% from long positions. Investors are now keenly awaiting the upcoming U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, which could influence future Federal Reserve interest-rate decisions and market sentiment.
title: Bitcoin Rebounds Amidst Asian Stock Sell-Off, CPI Report Looms

details: Strive, a Nasdaq-listed company, acquired 3,311 Bitcoin for approximately $280 million between October 5 and October 9, making it their largest weekly purchase since January. This acquisition boosts their total Bitcoin holdings to 32,773 BTC, funded primarily through warrant exercises. Strive aims to become the second-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holder by the end of 2026.
title: Strive Boosts Bitcoin Holdings with $280M Purchase

details: South Korea's Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) has ordered domestic internet access restrictions on 27 unregistered overseas cryptocurrency exchange websites, including major platforms like KuCoin, MEXC, BingX, Phemex, and BitMart. This expands a crackdown that previously targeted mobile applications. Operating without registration carries penalties of up to five years in prison or a 50 million won fine (approximately $37,000).
title: South Korea Blocks 27 Unregistered Crypto Exchange Websites

details: U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs recorded a net outflow of $85.4 million on October 12, marking the tenth consecutive day of net withdrawals. BlackRock's iShares Ethereum Trust (ETHA) accounted for $75.1 million of this outflow. Cumulative net outflows since September 29 now stand at approximately $782.8 million. Despite this, Ethereum's price rebounded above $2,500 on October 13.
title: Ethereum ETFs Face Tenth Consecutive Day of Outflows

details: XRP traded near $1.38 on October 13, down approximately 2.86% in 24 hours, with momentum indicators showing weakness. This dip occurs despite recent positive news, such as an Evernorth Nasdaq debut and a Standard Chartered Dubai deal, suggesting broader market sentiment and the specifics of the news items did not strongly motivate buying. XRP ETFs also recorded zero net flow on Monday, contrasting with earlier inflows.
title: XRP Price Dips Amid Weakening Momentum

details: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce, known as "Crypto Mom" for her pro-crypto stance, departed the agency on October 2, 2026, to become an associate professor at Regent University School of Law. Her departure leaves the SEC with only two commissioners, potentially impacting the pace and direction of future crypto rulemaking and policy decisions.
title: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce, "Crypto Mom," Departs
